name: io.github.cmssy-io/cmssy-mcp
title: cmssy
description: Headless CMS whose page sections are defined by your own code: pages, records, media, commerce.

environmentVariables.name: CMSSY_API_TOKEN
environmentVariables.description: Workspace API token, created in Dashboard > API Tokens. Starts with cs_.

environmentVariables.name: CMSSY_WORKSPACE_ID
environmentVariables.description: Id of the workspace the server reads and writes.

environmentVariables.name: CMSSY_API_URL
environmentVariables.description: Base URL of the cmssy backend the workspace lives on.
